title: Wire OpenClaw Anthropic API key and workspace ID through dev nonprod deploy transport and runtime env parity
summary: Wired DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID into PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh across initial optional defaults, usage() documentation, configure_management_ai_dev_kernel_env(), --dry-run boolean *_configured summaries (never logging secret values), ssh_bash command_prefix with shell_quote, and with_dev_bff_runtime_env for both formal root rollout and bff/Compose paths. Added recorder-backed parity and optional-omission contract tests in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_env_parity.py using synthetic values only.

ac1_deploy_nonprod_vm_wiring.evidence: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh initializes DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID to empty defaults (lines 81-82), documents them in usage() (line 426), maps them to PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID in configure_management_ai_dev_kernel_env() (lines 536-537), logs only boolean *_configured=true|false in --dry-run (lines 722-723), forwards shell-quoted PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID in ssh_bash command_prefix (lines 985-986), and exports both in with_dev_bff_runtime_env() (lines 4003-4004).

ac2_env_parity_recorder_tests.evidence: scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_env_parity.py uses _setup_stub_bin local recorder with synthetic values only (sk-ant-synthetic-test-key-0001, wrk_synthetic_test_0001) to verify identical PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID across formal root rollout and bff recreate Compose paths, and verifies optional omission defaults both to empty strings without adding new auth gates or altering deployment/rollback semantics.

ac3_scoped_files_and_validation.evidence: Only the 3 scoped files were modified; net production diff in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh is +11 lines (<= 40 budget). All focused env parity, strict auth default, runtime state, and artifact restore tests pass.
